title: {{name}} and the Little Star
summary: 帮暗淡小星星发光(鼓励):主角用望远镜看到不会发光的伤心小星星,鼓励它再试试,星星变亮成朋友。
text: Today {{name}} wants to see the stars. {{name}} has a big red telescope. The sky is dark and clear now. One star looks very sad. It is small and dim. "Do not be sad," says {{name}}. "I like you a lot." {{name}} wants to help the little star. {{name}} looks up at the sky. The big stars are bright. The little star is not bright. But it wants to shine too. {{name}} smiles at the little star. "You can do it," says {{name}}. "Try and try again!" The little star tries hard. Slowly, it gets brighter. Now it shines like the big stars! The little star is so happy. The sky looks more beautiful now. {{name}} is happy too. "Good star!" says {{name}}. The little star winks at {{name}}. They are good friends now. {{name}} looks up every night. The little star is always there.
